home.title: BEAM Club Workspace
home.subtitle: Internal member directory, department permissions, and Kanban task boards.
home.statusDescription: Bilingual Vietnamese/English navigation shell, UX permission helpers, and typed OpenAPI client are ready.

cards.boards: Kanban boards, columns, task cards, and Trash per club workstream.
cards.myTasks: Tasks assigned to you sorted by upcoming deadlines and priority.
cards.members: Club member directory by department with gated student ID and email visibility.
cards.profile: Inspect your own profile, effective permissions, and preferred language.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Use the student ID and password provided by an admin to enter the club workspace.
auth.rememberHint: Only tick this on your own device.
auth.helpNote: Accounts are created by an admin. There is no self sign-up or OTP. If you forget your password, ask an admin to reset it.
auth.devSeedHint: Dev environment: seed accounts use password BeamDev@2026
auth.invalidCredentials: Could not sign in. Check your student ID and password, or contact an admin.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again in a few minutes.
auth.rateLimitedWithWait: Too many attempts. Try again in {wait}.
auth.sessionExpiredBody: Please sign in again to continue. Unsaved content is not kept.
auth.networkError: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

showcase.kicker: One place for everything the club runs
showcase.headline: Every task has an owner, a deadline and a priority.
showcase.caption: Illustrative preview. Real club boards appear after you sign in.

profile.title: My profile
profile.subtitle: You only see your own student ID and email here.
profile.departmentsManagedByAdmin: Admins assign departments. You cannot change them yourself.
profile.permissionsManagedByAdmin: Admins grant permissions club-wide. Ask an admin for more.
profile.adminAllPermissions: Administrator account: holds all permissions across the club workspace.
profile.languageSyncedNote: Language preference is synced across the UI and deadline reminder emails.
profile.languageSaveError: Could not save language preference. Please try again.
profile.changePasswordSubtitle: Changing your password keeps this session active and signs out other devices.
profile.forceChangePasswordBody: You are using an initial or recently reset password. Please set a new password (at least 8 characters) now.
profile.passwordChangedBanner: Your password has been updated and other active sessions have been signed out.
profile.validationNewPassword: New password must be 8 to 128 characters and not whitespace only.
profile.validationConfirmMismatch: Password confirmation does not match the new password.

media.avatarHint: Supports PNG, JPEG, or WEBP up to 256 KB. Images larger than 512px are resized automatically before upload.

branding.modalSubtitle: Shown in the navigation bar, sign-in showcase, and error pages. Only admins can update it.
branding.uploadHint: Accepts PNG, JPEG, or WEBP up to 256 KB (auto-resized if needed). SVG is not allowed.

catalog.member_view: View club members, names, and departments
catalog.member_view_detail: View members' student IDs and emails
catalog.member_update: Update member details and department assignments
catalog.department_manage: Create, rename, and delete club departments
catalog.task_update_any: Update and move any visible task
catalog.task_update_assigned: Update and move tasks assigned to you
catalog.task_delete: Soft-delete and restore tasks from Trash

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
errors.conflict: This action conflicts with the current state.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Please try again later.
errors.internal: Server error occurred. Please try again later.
errors.invalidEmailDomain: Email must belong to the @{domain} domain.
errors.emailExists: This email is already assigned to another member.
errors.lastActiveAdmin: Cannot deactivate or remove the last active club admin.
errors.cannotRevokeOwnAdmin: You cannot revoke your own admin access.
errors.invalidDepartmentIds: One or more selected departments are invalid.
errors.studentIdImmutable: Student ID cannot be changed after account creation.
errors.invalidCursor: Invalid pagination cursor. Reload the list from the beginning.
errors.initialPasswordRequired: Initial password is required (at least 8 characters).
errors.departmentNameExists: A department with this name already exists.
errors.departmentInUse: Cannot delete this department because {memberCount} members and {boardCount} boards still reference it.
errors.invalidDateRange: Start date must be on or before end date.
errors.columnNotEmpty: Cannot delete this column because it still contains active tasks.
errors.taskVersionConflict: This task was updated by someone else. Reload the latest version before saving.
errors.invalidColumnOrder: Column order list is invalid. Please reload the board.
errors.invalidAssigneeIds: One or more selected assignees do not exist or have left the club.
errors.boardColumnMismatch: The selected column does not belong to this board.

errors.imageTooLarge: Image still exceeds 256 KB after compression. Please choose a smaller image.

errors.boardHasNoColumns: This board has no columns to place the restored task into. Create a column first.
errors.taskNotDeleted: This task is currently active and is not in the Archive.
errors.memberAlreadyActive: This member account is already active.
errors.boardNotArchived: This board is currently active and is not archived.
errors.entityNotArchived: Only items currently in the Archive can be permanently purged.

401.title: Sign in required
401.description: Sign in with your student ID to access this workspace.

403.title: You cannot view this page
403.description: This page needs a permission your account does not have. If you think this is a mistake, contact a club admin.

404.title: Page not found
404.description: The path does not exist, or you cannot view it. The system does not say which — including for hidden tasks.

409.title: Action conflict
409.description: This record changed or is still referenced elsewhere. Refresh to view the latest state.

429.title: Too many requests
429.description: You sent too many requests in a short time. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

500.title: Something went wrong
500.description: We logged it. Try again shortly; your last input may not be saved.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.description: Check your connection and try again. Unsent changes are not saved automatically.

sessionExpired.title: Your session has expired
sessionExpired.description: Sign in again to continue. Unsaved content is not kept.

members.title: Member directory
members.subtitle: Browse club members by name, department, and activity status.
members.privacyHint: Student IDs and emails are only shown to roles with member detail permission.
members.emptyDescription: Try clearing the search query or changing the department and status filters.

memberAdmin.title: Member admin
memberAdmin.subtitle: Add club members, update department assignments, and deactivate departing accounts.
memberAdmin.studentIdHint: Student ID cannot be changed after account creation.
memberAdmin.studentIdHiddenNotice: Student ID is hidden under your current permissions.
memberAdmin.emailPlaceholderMasked: Keep current email (or enter a new @{domain} email to replace it)
memberAdmin.departmentsEmpty: No departments yet. Create departments first.
memberAdmin.deactivateModalBody: This signs out {name} and marks the account as "(left)". All assigned tasks, comments, and event history remain preserved.
memberAdmin.activateModalBody: Restore sign-in access for {name} with their existing permissions.
memberAdmin.cannotListWithoutViewTitle: Member directory access is not enabled
memberAdmin.cannotListWithoutViewBody: Your account has member administration permissions, though it does not include member.view to list existing accounts.
memberAdmin.validationFullName: Enter a valid full name (1–120 characters).
memberAdmin.validationStudentId: Student ID is required (up to 64 characters).
memberAdmin.validationFormGeneric: Please check the highlighted form fields.
memberAdmin.initialPasswordHint: Minimum 8 characters. The member must change this password on first sign-in.
memberAdmin.validationInitialPassword: Initial password must be 8 to 128 characters and not whitespace only.
memberAdmin.resetPasswordModalBody: Set a new temporary password for {name}. All active sessions for this member will be terminated immediately, and they will be required to change it on next sign-in.
memberAdmin.validationNewPassword: New password must be 8 to 128 characters and not whitespace only.
memberAdmin.validationPasswordMismatch: Password confirmation does not match the new password.

departmentsAdmin.title: Departments admin
departmentsAdmin.subtitle: Manage club departments and inspect member and board usage before deleting.
departmentsAdmin.inUseSectionHint: Departments with active members or boards cannot be deleted (409).
departmentsAdmin.unusedSectionHint: Departments without linked members or boards can be deleted safely.
departmentsAdmin.emptyListDescription: Create the first department or adjust your search filter.
departmentsAdmin.deleteConfirmPrompt: Are you sure you want to delete "{name}"?
departmentsAdmin.deleteBlockedHint: Note: This department currently shows {memberCount} members and {boardCount} boards; deletion will be blocked (409) until reassigned.
departmentsAdmin.validationNameRequired: Department name must be 1 to 120 characters.

permissionsAdmin.title: Permissions
permissionsAdmin.subtitle: Select a member on the left to review and edit all 18 permission codes, apply presets, or toggle the admin flag.
permissionsAdmin.forbiddenDescription: This requires the admin flag, not a separate permission code.
permissionsAdmin.searchLabel: Find a member to edit permissions
permissionsAdmin.selectMemberPrompt: Select a member from the list to manage permissions.
permissionsAdmin.editingBanner: Editing {name}’s permissions. Changes apply club-wide, permanently, and are written to the audit log.
permissionsAdmin.inactiveWarning: This member has left the club. You can still inspect permissions or reactivate the account in Member admin.
permissionsAdmin.adminAccessNotice: This account holds the Admin flag and automatically has all workspace permissions regardless of individual checkboxes below.
permissionsAdmin.presetModalBody: This preset sets all {total} permissions of “{name}” and replaces all current grants. It cannot be undone after saving.
permissionsAdmin.adminSectionOnDesc: Grants full administrative access across the club workspace, including permission and admin management.
permissionsAdmin.adminSectionOffDesc: Restricted to the permissions selected in the 18-code matrix below.
permissionsAdmin.cannotRevokeSelfHint: You cannot remove your own admin access.

auditLogs.title: Audit log
auditLogs.subtitle: Append-only · no edits, no deletes
auditLogs.forbiddenTitle: You cannot view the audit log
auditLogs.forbiddenDescription: Requires audit.view. Even admins can only inspect records — edits and deletes are disabled.
auditLogs.emptyDescription: Try a wider date range or clear the action filter.
auditLogs.loadErrorTitle: Could not load the audit log
auditLogs.detailSelectPrompt: Select a row in the table to inspect details.
auditLogs.detailPrivacyNotice: Records hold no student ID or email. Names are resolved on read, not stored in the ledger.

boards.title: Boards
boards.subtitle: Select a board to manage columns, track task progress, and watch deadlines.
boards.emptyDescription: A board holds the columns and tasks for one area of work. Create the first board or adjust filters.
boards.emptyColumn: No tasks in this column yet.
boards.boardDepartmentHint: Each board belongs to at most one department or is club-wide.
boards.archiveModalBody: "{name}" will be moved to archived state without deleting tasks. Admins can restore it anytime.
boards.columnDeleteBody: Are you sure you want to delete column "{name}"? Active tasks must be moved out first (409 if non-empty).
boards.columnDeleteHasTasksWarn: This column currently shows {count} visible tasks; move them elsewhere before deleting.
boards.validationBoardName: Board name must be 1 to 120 characters.
boards.validationColumnName: Column name must be 1 to 80 characters.

tasks.dueAtHint: Leave blank if this task has no deadline.
tasks.departmentsHint: Department assignment is primary; active members of assigned departments can view and work on this task.
tasks.notifyDepartmentMembersLabel: Send notification & email to department members
tasks.notifyDepartmentMembersHint: Sends bell notifications and emails to active members of assigned departments (uncheck to skip).
tasks.assigneesRestrictedNote: Requires member.view to browse club members.
tasks.isHiddenLabel: Hide task (visible only to assignees, creator, and admins)
tasks.deleteConfirmBody: "{name}" will be removed from the board and moved to Trash.
tasks.readOnlyNotice: You have read-only access to this task.
tasks.validationTitle: Task title must be 1 to 200 characters.

myTasks.title: My tasks
myTasks.subtitle: Track tasks assigned to you by priority and deadline.
myTasks.doneNote: Tasks in the final (Done) column are hidden by default.
myTasks.emptyTitle: No assigned tasks match these filters
myTasks.emptyDescription: Assigned tasks appear here. You can also browse boards for non-hidden club work.

archive.title: Archive Center
archive.subtitle: Restore soft-deleted tasks, deactivated members, or archived boards. Only admins can permanently purge items or change auto-purge retention.
archive.forbiddenDescription: Requires at least one archive permission (task.delete, member.deactivate, or board.delete) or admin access.
archive.searchPlaceholder: Search by task title, name, or email...
archive.emptyDescription: Soft-deleted tasks, deactivated members, and archived boards appear here.
archive.deletedColumnFallback: Original column deleted (restores to first column)
archive.retentionAdminOnlyNote: Only admins can change the automatic purge retention schedule.
archive.retentionLoadError: Could not load archive retention policy.
archive.purgeModalBody: You are about to permanently purge {entityType} "{name}". This action cannot be undone.
archive.purgeModalHistoryNote: Personal identifiable data (PII) will be removed or anonymized while immutable audit logs and task history remain intact.
archive.privacyHint: Student ID and email are only shown with member.view_detail permission.

notifications.heading: Notifications
notifications.emptyDescription: When tasks are assigned to your department or to you, they will appear here.
notifications.hiddenTaskDepartmentAssigned: A hidden task was assigned to {departmentName}
notifications.hiddenTaskDepartmentAssignedNoDept: A hidden task was assigned to your department
notifications.hiddenTaskAssigned: A hidden task was assigned to you
